title: Appendix: Novel Glossary
content:
Appendix

Novel Glossary

Characters & Figures (59)

A-Ding (阿丁)

Affiliation: Mo Family Village | Aliases: 阿丁

A young maidservant serving in the Mo family household.

A-Qing (阿箐)

Affiliation: Yi City / Xiao Xingchen | Aliases: Little Blind Girl, A-Qing of Yi City, 阿箐, 阿菁

A spirited, street-smart young girl with clouded eyes and a bamboo pole who feigns complete blindness.

A-Tong (阿桐)

Affiliation: Mo Family Village | Aliases: 阿桐

A young servant boy employed in the Mo family household.

A-Yan (阿妍)

Affiliation: Buddha's Foot Town | Aliases: Blacksmith Zheng's daughter, 阿妍

A young woman from Buddha's Foot Town who inexplicably lost her sanity and wanders the streets dancing with a vacant smile.

Baoshan Sanren (抱山散人 (Bàoshān Sǎnrén))

Affiliation: Celestial Mountain | Aliases: Embracing Mountain Pilgrim, 抱山散人 (Bàoshān Sǎnrén)

A legendary, immortal cultivator who resides on a secluded celestial mountain and takes in disciples on the strict condition that once they leave her sanctuary to enter the mortal world, they can never return.

Bicao (碧草 / Bìcǎo)

Affiliation: Laoling Qin Clan | Aliases: Bìcǎo, 碧草, 碧草 / Bìcǎo

Bicao is Madam Qin's personal maid and trusted confidante.

Blacksmith Zheng (郑铁匠)

Affiliation: Buddha's Foot Town | Aliases: 郑铁匠

A blacksmith residing in Buddha's Foot Town and the father of A-Yan.

Cangse Sanren (藏色散人 (Cángsè Sǎnrén))

Affiliation: Baoshan Sanren's Lineage | Aliases: Rogue Cultivator Cangse, 藏色散人 (Cángsè Sǎnrén)

A highly talented rogue cultivator and former disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, renowned for her lively personality, exceptional spiritual power, and marriage to Wei Changze.

Chang Ci'an (常慈安 (Cháng Cí'ān))

Affiliation: Yueyang Chang Sect | Aliases: Chang Ci’an, Chang Ci-an, Leader Chang, 常慈安 (Cháng Cí'ān)

The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect who is established in the narrative through his early interactions with Xue Yang during the latter's youth.

Chang Ping (常萍)

Affiliation: Yueyang Chang Sect | Aliases: 常萍

The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect, a cultivation clan based in the Yueyang region.

Dancing Goddess (舞天女)

Affiliation: Dafan Mountain | Aliases: Venerable Dancing Goddess, Soul-Consuming Goddess, Dancing Goddess Statue, 舞天女

A ten-foot-tall stone statue sculpted by nature on Dafan Mountain

Fairy (仙子)

Affiliation: Jin Ling / Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Spiritual Dog, Jin Ling Dog, 仙子, 仙子 (Xiānzǐ)

A highly intelligent, ferocious black spiritual dog gifted to Jin Ling by Jin Guangyao.

Fang Mengchen (方梦臣 / Fāng Mèngchén)

Affiliation: Unspecified Cultivation Sect | Aliases: Fāng Mèngchén, 方梦臣 / Fāng Mèngchén

A young cultivator who harbors a deep personal grudge against Wei Wuxian and participates in the second siege of the Burial Mounds.

Jiang Cheng (江澄)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan | Aliases: Jiang Wanyin, Sandu Shengshou, Sect Leader Jiang, Cheng-ge, 江晚吟, 三毒圣手

The fiery, sharp-tongued, and fiercely protective leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan.

Jiang Fengmian (江枫眠)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan | Aliases: Sect Leader Jiang (Former), Uncle Jiang, 江枫眠

The calm, gentle, and open-minded former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan.

Jiang Yanli (江厌离)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: A-Li, Shijie, Lady Jin, Young Mistress Jin, 江厌离

A remarkably gentle, nurturing, and compassionate maiden of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan celebrated for her lotus and pork rib soup.

Jin Chan (金阐)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: 金阐

A junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan who participates in the Discussion Conference and the third-party hunts.

Jin Guangshan (金光善)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Sect Leader Jin (Former), Lord Jin, 金光善, Sect Leader Jin

The extravagant, self-indulgent, and politically calculating former leader of the Lanling Jin Clan.

Jin Guangyao (金光瑶)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Meng Yao, Lianfang-Zun, Chief Cultivator, A-Yao, 孟瑶, 敛芳尊

The polite, hardworking, and exceptionally tactful leader of the Lanling Jin Clan.

Jin Ling

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan / Yunmeng Jiang Clan | Aliases: Jin Rulan, A-Ling, Young Mistress, Young Master Jin, 金如兰, 金凌

A proud, short-tempered, and determined young cultivator of the Lanling Jin Clan.

Jin Rusong (金如松)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Sect | Aliases: Jīn Rúsōng, 金如松

Jin Rusong is the young son of Jin Guangyao and Qin Su of the Lanling Jin Sect.

Jin Zixuan (金子轩)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Peacock, Young Master Jin, Zixuan, 金子轩

The proud and aristocratic heir to the Lanling Jin Clan.

Jin Zixun (金子勋 / Jīn Zixūn)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Jīn Zixūn, 金子勋 / Jīn Zixūn

An arrogant and confrontational cultivator of the Lanling Jin Clan and cousin to Jin Zixuan.

Lan An (蓝安 (Lán Ān))

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect | Aliases: Lan An., Founder of Gusu Lan Sect, 蓝安 (Lán Ān)

The historical founder of the Gusu Lan Sect who was originally a temple monk before returning to secular life, choosing the surname Lan, and establishing the cultivation clan in Gusu after finding his fated partner.

Lan Jingyi

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Jingyi, 蓝景仪

A spirited, outspoken, and quick-witted junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan who frequently speaks his mind.

Lan Qiren (蓝启仁)

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Grandmaster Lan, Elder Lan, Teacher Lan, 蓝启仁, Master Lan, Uncle Lan

A notoriously strict and pedantic elder and teacher in the Gusu Lan Clan renowned for his unyielding discipline.

Lan Sizhui

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Lan Yuan, A-Yuan, 思追, 蓝愿, 蓝思追, Sizhui

A polite, sensible, and level-headed junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan renowned for his calm judgment.

Lan Wangji (蓝忘机)

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Lan Zhan, Hanguang-Jun, Second Young Master Lan, Second Master Lan, Wangji, Lan-er-gege

A remarkably righteous and austere cultivator renowned for his strict adherence to rules, exceptional musical talent, and icy demeanor.

Lan Xichen

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Zewu-Jun, Lan Huan, First Young Master Lan, Sect Leader Lan, 蓝涣, 泽芜君

The gentle, empathetic, and universally respected leader of the Gusu Lan Clan.

Little Apple (小苹果)

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Donkey, Xiao Pingguo, Wei Wuxian Donkey, 小苹果, 小苹果 (Xiǎo Píngguǒ)

A stubborn, mischievous, and bad-tempered donkey tamed by Wei Wuxian who will only move when baited with apples.

Madam Jin (金夫人 (Jīn Fūrén))

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Jin Furen, Mother of Jin Zixuan, 金夫人 (Jīn Fūrén)

The proud and strong-willed matriarch of the Lanling Jin Clan, who is a close friend of Madam Yu and the protective mother of Jin Zixuan.

Madam Mo (莫夫人)

Affiliation: Mo Family Village | Aliases: 莫夫人

The domineering and bitter matriarch of the Mo estate.

Madam Yu (虞紫鸢)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Meishan Yu Clan | Aliases: Yu Ziyuan, Violet Spider, Madam Yu of Meishan, 紫蜘蛛, 虞夫人, 虞紫鸢

The formidable, sharp-tongued, and fiercely proud mistress of Lotus Pier who wields the purple spiritual ring Zidian.

Master Mo (莫老爷)

Affiliation: Mo Family Village | Aliases: Mo Ziyuan's father, Madam Mo's husband, 莫老爷

The master of the Mo estate and Madam Mo's husband.

Meng Shi (孟诗)

Affiliation: Yunping | Aliases: Mèng Shī, 孟诗

An educated brothel worker from Yunping and the loving mother of Jin Guangyao.

Mianmian (罗青羊)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan / Rogue Cultivator | Aliases: Luo Qingyang, 绵绵, 罗青羊

A brave, principled, and outspoken female cultivator who refuses to follow corrupt clan politics.

Mo Xuanyu (莫玄羽)

Affiliation: Mo Village / Lanling Jin Clan (former) | Aliases: Young Master Mo, A-Yu, 莫玄羽

A troubled and eccentric former disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan residing within the secluded Mo estate.

Mo Ziyuan (莫子渊)

Affiliation: Mo Family Village | Aliases: Cousin Mo, 莫子渊

Mo Xuanyu arrogant cousin who abuses him and steals his magical talismans.

Nie Huaisang (聂怀桑)

Affiliation: Qinghe Nie Clan | Aliases: Head-Shaker, Sect Leader Nie, Nie-xiong, Nie Zong, 聂怀桑, Head-Shaking Sect Leader

A timid and seemingly inept cultivator who prefers collecting fans, birds, and painted scrolls over martial training.

Nie Mingjue (聂明玦)

Affiliation: Qinghe Nie Clan | Aliases: Chifeng-Zun, Sect Leader Nie, 赤锋尊, 聂明玦, Nie Mingjiao

The strict, imposing, and uncompromising former leader of the Qinghe Nie Clan who wields the heavy saber Baxia.

Ouyang Zizhen (欧阳子真)

Affiliation: Baling Ouyang Clan | Aliases: 欧阳子真

A young cultivator belonging to the Baling Ouyang Clan who frequently travels and participates in various night-hunts alongside his generational peers.

Qin Su (秦愫 (Qín Sù))

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Sect | Aliases: A-Su, 秦愫 (Qín Sù)

The gentle and supportive wife of Jin Guangyao, who was raised as the daughter of the Laoling Qin Sect's leader.

Qingheng-jun (青蘅君)

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Qīnghéng-jūn, 青蘅君

The former leader of the Gusu Lan Clan, who is the older brother of Lan Qiren and the father of Lan Xichen and Lan Wangji.

Song Lan (宋岚)

Affiliation: Baixue Temple / Independent Cultivators | Aliases: Song Zichen, Distant Snow and Cold Frost, 宋子琛, 宋岚

A tall, austere Taoist cultivator from Baixue Temple and close companion of Xiao Xingchen.

Su She (苏涉)

Affiliation: Moling Su Clan / Gusu Lan Clan (former) | Aliases: Su Minshan, Sect Leader Su, Moling Su Sect Leader, 苏悯善, 苏涉, Minshan

The insecure and ambitious founder of the Moling Su Clan, formerly a disciple of Gusu Lan.

Wang Lingjiao (王灵娇)

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Clan | Aliases: Lingjiao, Mistress Wang, 王灵娇

The vain, spiteful, and cruel favorite concubine of Wen Chao.

Wei Changze (魏长泽)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Sect | Aliases: 魏长泽

The father of Wei Wuxian, who formerly served as a subordinate and close companion to Sect Leader Jiang Fengmian of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect before departing to travel with the rogue cultivator Cangse Sanren.

Wei Wuxian (魏无羡)

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Sect | Aliases: Wei Ying, Yiling Patriarch, Yiling Laozu, A-Xian, A-Ying, Senior Wei

An eccentric and brilliant cultivator known for his unconventional thinking, quick wit, and mastery over resentful energy.

Wen Chao (温晁)

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Clan | Aliases: Second Young Master Wen, Young Master Wen, 温晁

The arrogant, cowardly, and boastful second son of Wen Ruohan.

Wen Mao (温卯)

Aliases: Qishan Wen Clan, 温卯

The founding ancestor of the Qishan Wen Sect who first elevated the clan above the sect to usher in the age of hereditary houses.

Wen Ning (温宁)

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Clan / Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Wen Qionglin, Ghost General, A-Ning, 温琼林, 鬼将军, 温宁

A gentle and soft-spoken young cultivator from the Qishan Wen Clan skilled in archery and known for his fierce loyalty.

Wen Qing (温情)

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Clan | Aliases: Lady Wen, Doctor Wen, A-Qing (Wen), 温情

A proud, extraordinarily skilled physician and senior cultivator from a branch family of the Qishan Wen Clan.

Wen Ruohan (温若寒)

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Clan | Aliases: Sect Leader Wen, Chief Cultivator Wen, 温若寒, Chief Cultivator, Wen-zongzhu, 温若寒 / Wēn Ruòhán

The tyrannical, all-powerful leader of the Qishan Wen Clan who commands the Nightless City.

Wen Xu (温旭 (Wēn Xù))

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Sect | Aliases: 温旭 (Wēn Xù)

The eldest son of Sect Leader Wen Ruohan and a prominent, authoritative cultivator within the Qishan Wen Sect.

Wen Zhuliu

Affiliation: Qishan Wen Sect | Aliases: Core-Melting Hand, Hua Dan Shou, Zhao Zhuliu, 温逐流 (Wēn Zhúlíú)

A powerful and loyal cultivator serving the Qishan Wen Sect, feared throughout the cultivation world for his unique ability to dissolve a cultivator's golden core.

Xiao Xingchen (晓星尘)

Affiliation: Baixue Temple / Independent Cultivators | Aliases: Daozhang, Bright Moon and Gentle Breeze, 晓星尘

A compassionate, noble-hearted rogue cultivator who left his mountain hermitage to aid common mortals.

Xue Yang (薛洋)

Affiliation: Kuizhou / Lanling Jin Clan (Guest) | Aliases: Xue Chengmei, Chengmei, 薛成美, 薛洋

A cunning, ruthless, and streetwise young rogue cultivator known for his wicked smile and candy addiction.

Yanling Daoren (延灵道人 (Yánlíng Dàorén))

Affiliation: Baoshan Sanren's Lineage | Aliases: Daoist Yanling, 延灵道人 (Yánlíng Dàorén)

The first disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, who chose to descend from his teacher's secluded mountain to enter the mortal world as a rogue cultivator.

Yi Weichun (易为春)

Affiliation: Unspecified Clan | Aliases: Yì Wéichūn, 易为春

A middle-aged cultivator who wears a wooden prosthetic leg and harbors deep resentment toward Wei Wuxian following the battle at Nightless City.

Weapons, Artifacts & Items (24)

Baxia (霸下)

Affiliation: Nie Mingjue / Qinghe Nie Clan | Aliases: Under Siege, Nie Mingjue Saber, 霸下, 霸下 (Bàxià)

A massive, fiercely spirited saber wielded by Nie Mingjue with immense destructive force.

Bichen (避尘)

Affiliation: Lan Wangji / Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Avoid Dust, Lan Wangji Sword, Bìchén, 避尘, 避尘 (Bìchén)

A pristine, ice-cold spiritual sword wielded by Lan Wangji, celebrated for its razor-sharp crystal blade.

Chenqing (陈情)

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Flute of Resentment, Black Flute, Ghost Flute, 陈情, Chénqíng-di, 陈情 (Chénqíng)

A dark, jet-black dizi (bamboo flute) adorned with red tassels used by Wei Wuxian to command spirits and corpses.

Clarity Bell

Affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Sect | Aliases: Qingxin Bell, Clearing-Heart Bell, Nine-Petaled Lotus Clarity Bell, 清心铃 (Qīngxīn Líng)

A silver bell adorned with the nine-petaled lotus motif worn at the waist by Yunmeng Jiang Clan members to steady the mind and dispel malevolent illusions.

Compass of Evil (风邪盘)

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian (Invention) | Aliases: Fengxie Pan, Evil-Attracting Compass, Wind-Evil Compass, 风邪盘, Evil-Pointing Compass, Compass of Ghostly Direction

A groundbreaking magical compass invented by Wei Wuxian that spins to indicate the direction of malevolent spirits.

Deity-Binding Net (缚仙网 (Fùxiān Wǎng))

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Sect | Aliases: Deity-Binding Nets, Immortal-Binding Net, Fuxian Wang, 缚仙网 (Fùxiān Wǎng)

An expensive, high-grade spiritual tool woven from gold thread that is used by cultivators to capture spiritual beasts, deities, and malevolent prey.

Emperor's Smile (天子笑 (Tiānzǐ Xiào))

Affiliation: Caiyi Town, Gusu | Aliases: Tianzi Xiao, Famous Gusu Liquor, 天子笑, 天子笑 (Tiānzǐ Xiào)

A celebrated, fragrant jarred wine brewed exclusively in Caiyi Town of Gusu.

Fuxue (拂雪)

Affiliation: Song Lan | Aliases: Brushing Snow, Song Lan Sword, 拂雪, Fuxue Sword, 拂雪 (Fúxuě)

A long, pristine spiritual sword carried on the back of Song Lan.

Hensheng (恨生)

Affiliation: Jin Guangyao | Aliases: Hate Life, Jin Guangyao Sword, 恨生, 恨生 (Hènshēng)

A flexible, razor-thin soft sword concealed around Jin Guangyao waist.

Jiangzai (降灾)

Affiliation: Xue Yang | Aliases: Descend Calamity, Xue Yang Sword, 降灾, Disaster Bringer

A sinister, slender spiritual sword with a hooked blade wielded by Xue Yang.

Liebing (裂冰)

Affiliation: Lan Xichen / Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Ice Fracturer, Lan Xichen Xiao, 裂冰, Ice Fracture, 裂冰 (Lièbīng)

A delicate white jade xiao (vertical flute) played by Lan Xichen to pacify disturbed spirits.

Passage Jade Token (通行玉令 (Tōngxíng Yùlìng))

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect | Aliases: jade passage token, passage jade, entry jade token, jade entry pass, Tongxing Yuling, jade passage tokens

A specialized jade talisman carried by members and authorized guests of the Gusu Lan Sect to safely navigate and bypass the protective barrier surrounding the Cloud Recesses.

Qiankun Pouch (乾坤袋)

Affiliation: Common Cultivation Item | Aliases: Universe Bag, Holding Pouch, Spiritual Storage Pouch, 乾坤袋, Qiankun bag, Cosmos bag

A spiritual fabric pouch with an expanded spatial dimension inside for carrying large artifacts.

Sandu (三毒)

Affiliation: Jiang Cheng / Yunmeng Jiang Clan | Aliases: Three Poisons, Jiang Cheng Sword, 三毒, Sandu Sword, 三毒 (Sāndú)

The sharp and agile spiritual sword wielded by Jiang Cheng, named after the three Buddhist poisons.

Shuanghua (霜华)

Affiliation: Xiao Xingchen | Aliases: Frost Bloom, Xiao Xingchen Sword, 霜华, Frost Work, Frost Brilliance, 霜华 (Shuānghuá)

A graceful spiritual sword etched with frost patterns that warns of corpse activity.

Shuoyue (朔月)

Affiliation: Lan Xichen / Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: New Moon, Lan Xichen Sword, 朔月

The elegant spiritual sword wielded by Lan Xichen, matching his pure and upright character.

Spirit-Attraction Flag (招魂幡 (Zhāohún fān) / 招阴旗 (Zhāoyīn qí))

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian (Invention) | Aliases: Zhaohun Fan, Ghost-Luring Flag, Spirit-Luring Flag, 招魂幡, Spirit-Attraction Talisman, Attraction Flag

A talisman-inscribed flag invented by Wei Wuxian that acts as bait to lure ghosts and dark creatures.

Spirit-Locking Pouch (锁灵囊)

Affiliation: Cultivation World | Aliases: Suoling Nang, Spirit-Trapping Pouch, Lock-Spirit Pouch, 锁灵囊

A specialized spiritual pouch used by cultivators to safely trap, store, and preserve spirits, soul fragments, or resentful energy.

Suibian (随便)

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian / Yunmeng Jiang Clan | Aliases: Whatever, Wei Wuxian Sword, 随便, Suíbiàn, 随便 (Suíbiàn)

Wei Wuxian personal spiritual sword, forged with an unusual name meaning Whatever.

Suihua (岁华)

Affiliation: Jin Zixuan / Jin Ling | Aliases: Years Bloom, Jin Zixuan Sword, Jin Ling Sword, 岁华, Suihua Sword, Suìhuá-jiàn

An opulent, golden-hilt spiritual sword forged in Lanling Jin Clan passed from Jin Zixuan to Jin Ling.

Transportation Talisman (传送符 (Chuánsòng Fú))

Affiliation: Cultivation World | Aliases: Teleportation Talisman, Distance-Shortening Talisman, Chuansong Fu, Suodi Fu, 传送符, 传送符 (Chuánsòng Fú)

A specialized spiritual paper charm that allows a cultivator to instantly transport themselves or objects across great distances at the cost of a significant amount of spiritual energy.

Wangji Guqin (忘机琴)

Affiliation: Lan Wangji / Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Seven-Stringed Guqin, Lan Wangji Guqin, 忘机琴

The antique seven-stringed zither used by Lan Wangji for Inquiry and chord assassination techniques.

Yin Tiger Tally (阴虎符)

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Yinhu Fu, Tiger Amulet, Stygian Tiger Amulet, 阴虎符, Stygian Tiger Seal, Stygian Tiger Tally

A catastrophic artifact crafted by Wei Wuxian from dark iron capable of controlling thousands of resentful corpses.

Zidian (紫电)

Affiliation: Madam Yu / Jiang Cheng | Aliases: Purple Lightning, Madam Yu Ring, Jiang Cheng Whip, 紫电

A powerful first-class spiritual ring that transforms on command into a crackling whip of purple lightning.

Clans & Cultivation Sects (10)

Baling Ouyang Clan (巴陵欧阳氏)

Affiliation: Baling | Aliases: Baling Ouyang Sect, Ouyang Clan, 巴陵欧阳氏

A prominent middle-tier cultivation clan home to junior disciple Ouyang Zizhen.

Gusu Lan Clan

Affiliation: Cloud Recesses, Gusu | Aliases: Gusu Lan Sect, Lan Clan, Lan Sect, 姑苏蓝氏, Gusu Lan, Lan Clan of Gusu

A scholarly and austere cultivation clan founded by Lan An, renowned for their forehead ribbons, musical cultivation, and thousands of strict rules.

Lanling Jin Clan (兰陵金氏)

Affiliation: Koi Tower, Lanling | Aliases: Lanling Jin Sect, Jin Clan, Jin Sect, 兰陵金氏, Jin Clan of Lanling, Lanling Jin

An immensely wealthy and opulent cultivation clan famous for their golden robes, Sparks Amidst Snow peony motif, and forehead vermilion marks.

Leling Qin Clan (乐陵秦氏 (Lèlíng Qín Shì))

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Sect | Aliases: Leling Qin Sect, Qin Clan of Leling, 乐陵秦氏 (Lèlíng Qín Shì)

A minor cultivation clan based in Leling that is subordinate to and closely affiliated with the prominent Lanling Jin Sect.

Meishan Yu Clan (眉山虞氏)

Affiliation: Meishan | Aliases: Meishan Yu Sect, Yu Clan, 眉山虞氏, Yu Clan of Meishan, Yu Sect of Meishan

An ancient, matrilineally influential cultivation clan in Meishan and the birthplace of Madam Yu.

Moling Su Clan (秣陵苏氏)

Affiliation: Moling | Aliases: Moling Su Sect, Su Clan, Su Sect, 秣陵苏氏, Su Clan of Moling, 秣陵苏氏 (Mòlíng Sū Shì)

A newly emerged cultivation clan founded by Su She that imitates the musical techniques of the Gusu Lan Clan.

Qinghe Nie Clan

Affiliation: Impure Realm, Qinghe | Aliases: Qinghe Nie Sect, Nie Clan, Nie Sect, 清河聂氏, Qinghe Nie, Nie Sect of Qinghe

A rugged martial clan descended from butchers who cultivate the violent saber path instead of swords.

Qishan Wen Clan (岐山温氏)

Affiliation: Nightless City, Qishan | Aliases: Qishan Wen Sect, Wen Clan, Wen Sect, 岐山温氏, 岐山温氏 (Qíshān Wēn Shì), Qishan Wen

A massive, tyrannical clan historically dominating the cultivation world with their scorching sun motif.

Yueyang Chang Clan (岳阳常氏)

Affiliation: Yueyang | Aliases: Yueyang Chang Sect, Chang Clan, 岳阳常氏, Yueyang, Chang Sect of Yueyang, 岳阳常氏 (Yuèyáng Cháng Shì)

A regional cultivation clan in Yueyang governed by Chang Ci an.

Yunmeng Jiang Clan (云梦江氏)

Affiliation: Lotus Pier, Yunmeng | Aliases: Yunmeng Jiang Sect, Jiang Clan, Jiang Sect, 云梦江氏, Jiang Clan of Yunmeng, 云梦江氏 (Yúnmèng Jiāng Shì)

A lakeside cultivation clan known for their free-spirited maritime ethos, lotus motif, and nine-petal lotus silver clarity bells.

Locations, Towns & Realms (34)

Baifeng Mountain (百凤山)

Affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan | Aliases: Mount Baifeng, Baifeng Shan, Grand Hunt Mountain, 百凤山

A scenic mountain range in Lanling that serves as the prestigious venue for the Grand Cultivation Hunt.

Baixue Temple (白雪观)

Affiliation: Song Lan / Independent Cultivators | Aliases: Baixue Monastery, White Snow Temple, Song Lan Temple, 白雪观

A peaceful Taoist monastery established by Song Lan and his master high in the mountains.

Burial Mounds (乱葬岗)

Affiliation: Yiling / Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Luanzang Gang, Luanzang Hill, Mass Graves of Yiling, 乱葬岗, Yiling Burial Mounds, 乱葬岗 (Luànzàng Gǎng)

An ancient, corpse-strewn battlefield and mass grave in Yiling heavily saturated with dark resentful energy.

Caiyi Town (彩衣镇)

Affiliation: Gusu Lan Clan | Aliases: Caiyi, Water Town of Gusu, 彩衣镇

A lively water canal town situated near the foot of the mountain leading to Cloud Recesses, famous for its loquats and Emperor Smile liquor.

Dafan Mountain (大梵山)

Affiliation: Qishan Region | Aliases: Mount Dafan, Dafan Shan, Buddha Feet Mountain, 大梵山

A sacred mountain shaped like a seated Buddha home to ancient stone shrines and a prominent soul-consuming goddess statue.

Demon-Subduing Cave (伏魔洞 (Fúmó Dòng))

Affiliation: Wei Wuxian | Aliases: Fumo Cave, Fumo Dong, 伏魔洞 (Fúmó Dòng)

A large cavern on the Burial Mounds that serves as Wei Wuxian's residence and cultivation workshop during his time as the Yiling Patriarch.
